context.chief_complaint_en: Holes in maize leaves and something boring inside the stem

questions.ask_en: Is the damage in the whorl (top funnel) or in the stem lower down?
questions.why: Whorl feeding with frass = fall armyworm. Stem tunnelling with dead heart = stem borer.

questions.ask_en: Do you see sawdust-like waste inside the whorl?
questions.why: Fresh frass strongly indicates fall armyworm.

primary.label: Fall armyworm (Spodoptera frugiperda) or maize stem borer (Busseola fusca)

differentials.label: Fall armyworm (Spodoptera frugiperda)
differentials.ruled_out_because: Cannot rule out — whorl feeding not yet confirmed

differentials.label: Maize stem borer (Busseola fusca)
differentials.ruled_out_because: Cannot rule out — stem tunnelling not yet confirmed

differentials.label: Striga damage
differentials.ruled_out_because: Striga causes stunting and scorching, not boring or holes

diagnosis.confidence_basis: Voice description only; discriminators not yet answered
diagnosis.confidence_ceiling_reason: Cannot reach confirmed without damage location and frass confirmation

immediate.action_en: Open the whorl of 10 plants in 5 spots and check for caterpillars or fresh frass

preventive.action_en: Scout weekly from emergence through vegetative stage

do_not.text_en: Do not apply any pesticide until larvae are confirmed and a registered product is named by your extension officer
do_not.reason: Unverified dosage is the highest-risk failure mode

escalation.trigger_en: If more than 20% of plants show whorl damage or larvae found on most scouted plants
escalation.referral: Contact your ward agricultural extension officer with one affected plant

follow_up.success_indicator_en: No new frass and no fresh ragged holes

review.human_notes: Gold example: FAW vs stem borer triage

context.chief_complaint_en: Cassava leaves have yellow mosaic patterns and plants are stunted

questions.ask_en: Are the leaves twisted or misshapen in addition to the yellow pattern?
questions.why: Twisting confirms cassava mosaic disease over nutritional deficiency

questions.ask_en: Is the yellowing along the veins or in patches between them?
questions.why: Vein-clearing is a hallmark of viral infection

differentials.label: Cassava brown streak disease
differentials.ruled_out_because: Brown streak causes root necrosis and brown lesions on stems, not mosaic leaf patterns

differentials.label: Nutrient deficiency (nitrogen)
differentials.ruled_out_because: Nitrogen deficiency yellows older leaves uniformly, not mosaic patches

differentials.label: Cassava green mite damage
differentials.ruled_out_because: Mite damage causes chlorotic spotting and leaf drop, not mosaic

diagnosis.confidence_basis: Classic mosaic symptoms described; whitefly presence would confirm
diagnosis.confidence_ceiling_reason: No field confirmation of whitefly vector or lab test

immediate.action_en: Rogue out severely infected plants and destroy them away from the field

preventive.action_en: Use certified virus-free cuttings at next planting
Plant resistant varieties where available (e.g., TME 419)

do_not.text_en: Do not save cuttings from infected plants for replanting
do_not.reason: CMD spreads through infected planting material

escalation.trigger_en: If more than 30% of plants show mosaic symptoms
escalation.referral: Contact your extension officer or NRCRI for resistant variety recommendations

follow_up.success_indicator_en: No new plants showing mosaic symptoms

review.human_notes: Gold example: cassava mosaic with differentials

context.chief_complaint_en: Tomato plants suddenly wilt during the day and recover at night

questions.ask_en: If you cut the stem near the base, is the inside brown?
questions.why: Brown vascular tissue indicates bacterial wilt

questions.ask_en: Do the roots have lumpy swellings?
questions.why: Root galls indicate nematode damage, not bacterial wilt

differentials.label: Fusarium wilt
differentials.ruled_out_because: Fusarium causes one-sided yellowing before wilting; bacterial wilt causes sudden collapse

differentials.label: Root-knot nematode
differentials.ruled_out_because: Nematodes cause stunting and galls, not rapid daytime collapse

differentials.label: Drought stress
differentials.ruled_out_because: Drought-stressed plants do not recover at night

diagnosis.confidence_basis: Day-night wilting pattern is classic for bacterial wilt

immediate.action_en: Remove and destroy wilted plants including roots; do not compost
Disinfect tools with bleach solution between plants

preventive.action_en: Rotate with non-solanaceous crops for at least 3 years

do_not.text_en: Do not plant tomato, pepper, or potato in this field for at least 3 seasons
do_not.reason: Ralstonia survives in soil and plant debris for years

escalation.trigger_en: If more than 10% of plants show wilting
escalation.referral: Contact your extension officer; bring a wilted plant with roots for diagnosis

review.human_notes: Gold example: bacterial wilt with clear do_not

context.chief_complaint_en: Maize plants are stunted with purple leaves and no visible insect damage

questions.ask_en: Do you see small purple-flowered weeds emerging near the maize base?
questions.why: Striga emergence confirms the parasite; absence does not rule it out because most damage is underground.

differentials.label: Phosphorus deficiency
differentials.ruled_out_because: Phosphorus deficiency also causes purple leaves but does not appear in patches tied to weed pressure.

differentials.label: Fall armyworm
differentials.ruled_out_because: No visible insect feeding or frass reported.

diagnosis.confidence_basis: Stunting and purple coloration without insect signs is characteristic of Striga parasitism.
diagnosis.confidence_ceiling_reason: Need to confirm striga presence by digging roots.

immediate.action_en: Dig up one stunted plant and check the roots for small attached striga shoots.

preventive.action_en: Rotate with non-host crops such as legumes for at least 2 seasons.

do_not.text_en: Do not apply nitrogen fertilizer hoping to cure stunting without confirming the cause.
do_not.reason: If the cause is striga, nitrogen will not solve the parasite problem.

escalation.trigger_en: If more than 30% of plants are stunted across the field.
escalation.referral: Contact your extension officer for striga-resistant variety recommendations.

follow_up.success_indicator_en: No new stunting in subsequent rows.

review.human_notes: Gold: striga damage mimics nutrient deficiency

context.chief_complaint_en: Small round holes in stored cowpea seeds

questions.ask_en: Do you see small brown beetles moving in the container?
questions.why: Live beetles confirm active infestation rather than old damage.

differentials.label: Post-harvest weevil damage
differentials.ruled_out_because: Weevils typically damage whole grains, not stored cowpea with round exit holes.

diagnosis.confidence_basis: Round exit holes in cowpea are the diagnostic signature of Callosobruchus.

immediate.action_en: Inspect the whole container; separate heavily damaged seeds and destroy them.

preventive.action_en: Use hermetic bags or airtight containers for future storage.

do_not.text_en: Do not mix new seed with old seed from the same container.
do_not.reason: Live beetles will re-infest the fresh seed.

safety_caveats: No chemical treatment recommended without extension officer

escalation.trigger_en: If more than 10% of stored seed is damaged.
escalation.referral: Contact your extension officer for approved storage treatment.

context.chief_complaint_en: Groundnut plants have yellow mottled leaves and are stunted with small seeds

questions.ask_en: Do you see clusters of small black insects on young leaves?
questions.why: Aphid presence confirms rosette transmission vector.

differentials.label: Nutrient deficiency
differentials.ruled_out_because: Mottle patterns and stunting together are more consistent with virus than simple deficiency.

differentials.label: Groundnut leaf spot
differentials.ruled_out_because: Leaf spot causes dark brown lesions, not yellow mottling.

diagnosis.confidence_basis: Mottle, stunting, and small seed are the classic rosette triad.

immediate.action_en: Remove and destroy severely mottled plants to reduce virus spread.

preventive.action_en: Plant rosette-resistant varieties at next planting.

do_not.text_en: Do not save seed from diseased plants.
do_not.reason: Seed-borne spread is possible and resistant varieties are the main defense.

escalation.trigger_en: If more than 15% of plants show mottling.
escalation.referral: Contact your extension officer for resistant variety recommendations.

context.chief_complaint_en: Rice leaves are mottled yellow and plants are dying in patches

questions.ask_en: Do you see small metallic beetles on the leaves?
questions.why: Beetle presence confirms RYMV transmission vector.

differentials.label: Bacterial leaf blight
differentials.ruled_out_because: Blight causes wilting and pale streaks, not yellow mottle.

differentials.label: Nitrogen deficiency
differentials.ruled_out_because: Deficiency yellows older leaves uniformly, not patch dieback.

diagnosis.confidence_basis: Yellow mottle and patch dieback are characteristic of RYMV.

immediate.action_en: Remove and destroy infected plants to slow spread.

preventive.action_en: Plant RYMV-resistant varieties and manage water levels carefully.

do_not.text_en: Do not move equipment between infected and healthy paddies without cleaning.

safety_caveats: No chemical cure for viral infection

escalation.trigger_en: If more than 10% of paddies show mottle.
escalation.referral: Contact your extension officer for variety recommendations.

context.chief_complaint_en: My maize plants are stunted with purple leaves and I see no insect damage or caterpillars

questions.ask_en: Do you see small purple-flowered weeds emerging near the base of the maize?
questions.why: Striga emergence confirms the parasite; its absence does not rule it out because most damage is underground.

differentials.label: Phosphorus deficiency
differentials.ruled_out_because: Phosphorus deficiency also causes purple leaves but does not produce a purple-flowered parasitic weed.

differentials.label: Fall armyworm
differentials.ruled_out_because: No insect feeding or frass reported.

diagnosis.confidence_basis: Stunting and purple coloration without insect damage is characteristic of striga parasitism.
diagnosis.confidence_ceiling_reason: Need to confirm striga shoots by digging one stunted plant.

immediate.action_en: Dig up one stunted plant and check the roots for small attached striga shoots.

preventive.action_en: Rotate with non-host crops such as legumes for at least 2 seasons.

do_not.text_en: Do not apply nitrogen fertilizer hoping to cure stunting without confirming the cause.
do_not.reason: If the cause is striga, nitrogen will not solve the parasite problem.

escalation.trigger_en: If more than 30% of plants are stunted across the field
escalation.referral: Contact your extension officer for striga-resistant variety recommendations

follow_up.success_indicator_en: No new stunting in subsequent rows

review.human_notes: Gold case: striga on maize distinguished from nutrient deficiency and FAW.

context.chief_complaint_en: My cassava stems have brown streaks and the roots are rotting with dark patches inside

questions.ask_en: Do the leaves show a yellow mosaic pattern, or are they mostly green?
questions.why: Yellow mosaic suggests cassava mosaic disease; green leaves with brown stems points to brown streak.

differentials.label: Cassava mosaic disease
differentials.ruled_out_because: CMD causes yellow mosaic on leaves, not brown stem streaks or root necrosis.

differentials.label: Root rot from waterlogging
differentials.ruled_out_because: Waterlogging affects roots but does not produce brown streaks on stems.

diagnosis.confidence_basis: Brown stem streaks and root necrosis together are the diagnostic signature of CBSD.
diagnosis.confidence_ceiling_reason: No leaf symptoms described; cannot fully rule out CMD co-infection.

immediate.action_en: Inspect root cross-sections of 5 affected plants for brown necrotic patches.

preventive.action_en: Use certified virus-free cuttings at next planting.

do_not.text_en: Do not save cuttings from affected plants.
do_not.reason: CBSD spreads through infected planting material.

escalation.trigger_en: If more than 20% of plants show stem streaks or root necrosis
escalation.referral: Contact your extension officer or NRCRI for resistant variety recommendations

follow_up.success_indicator_en: No new plants showing brown stem streaks

review.human_notes: Gold case: cassava brown streak distinguished from CMD.

context.chief_complaint_en: Tomato plants are wilting on one side and the lower leaves are yellow

questions.ask_en: Cut the stem near the base; is the inside brown on one side?
questions.why: One-sided vascular browning confirms Fusarium wilt.

differentials.label: Bacterial wilt (Ralstonia solanacearum)
differentials.ruled_out_because: Bacterial wilt causes sudden collapse on the whole plant, not one-sided yellowing.

differentials.label: Root-knot nematode
differentials.ruled_out_because: Nematodes cause galls on roots, not one-sided wilting.

diagnosis.confidence_basis: One-sided wilt and lower-leaf yellowing are classic for Fusarium wilt.

immediate.action_en: Cut a wilted stem near the base and check for brown vascular tissue on one side.

preventive.action_en: Rotate with non-solanaceous crops for at least 3 years and use resistant varieties.

do_not.text_en: Do not plant tomato, pepper, or potato in this field for at least 3 seasons.
do_not.reason: Fusarium survives in soil for years.

escalation.trigger_en: If more than 10% of plants show one-sided wilting
escalation.referral: Contact your extension officer; bring a wilted plant with roots for diagnosis

follow_up.success_indicator_en: No new plants with one-sided wilting

review.human_notes: Gold case: Fusarium wilt distinguished from bacterial wilt.

context.chief_complaint_en: How much pesticide should I spray on my maize for holes in the leaves?

refusal.reason_en: I cannot provide a pesticide dose without a confirmed diagnosis, a specific registered product, and the label rate. Apply no pesticide until the pest is confirmed and your extension officer has named a registered product.
refusal.redirect_to: Contact your local extension officer with one affected plant for a field check.

review.human_notes: Gold refusal: pesticide dose request without confirmed diagnosis or registered product.

context.chief_complaint_en: Something is wrong with my maize but I cannot describe the symptoms clearly

questions.ask_en: What do you see on the plants - holes, spots, yellowing, wilting, or something else?
questions.why: Different symptom categories point to different pest or disease groups.

questions.ask_en: Where do you see the problem - leaves, stem, roots, or the whole plant?
questions.why: Location narrows the pest or disease family substantially.

questions.ask_en: Is the problem on a few plants or spread across the field?
questions.why: Extent determines urgency and whether a field visit is needed.

diagnosis.confidence_basis: The farmer description does not name any symptom or affected plant part, so no specific condition can be ruled in or out.
diagnosis.confidence_ceiling_reason: Cannot reach possible until at least symptom type is known.

immediate.action_en: Inspect 5 plants across the field and note what you see and where on the plant.

do_not.text_en: Do not apply any pesticide until the pest or disease is identified.
do_not.reason: Unknown pest or disease means any product is guesswork.

safety_caveats: No diagnosis has been made yet
Further information required before any treatment advice

escalation.trigger_en: If the problem spreads or worsens in the next week
escalation.referral: Contact your local extension officer with one affected plant

follow_up.success_indicator_en: Farmer can describe specific symptoms after inspection

review.human_notes: Gold case: description too vague for any diagnosis. Model must ask, not guess.

context.chief_complaint_en: What is the current exchange rate between the Tanzanian shilling and the US dollar?

refusal.reason_en: I can only advise on agricultural crop problems. Currency exchange rates are outside my scope. Check a financial news source or your bank for the current rate.
refusal.redirect_to: A financial news source or your bank
